english.title: Fail to comply with a notice to prevent water falling / flowing onto persons / the highway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been served with a notice under section 163 of the Highways Act 1980 requiring you to construct or erect and thereafter to maintain such channels, gutters or downpipes as may be necessary to prevent

(A)_[water from the roof or another part of the premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) owned or occupied by you falling upon persons using the highway]_
(B)_[so far as was reasonably practicable, surface water from the premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) owned or occupied by you flowing on to, or over, the footway or the highway]_

failed to comply with that notice within 28 days of its service on you
english.legislation: Contrary to section 163(4) of the Highways Act 1980.

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level 1 on the standard scale and if the offence is continued after conviction he is guilty of a further offence and to a further fine of £2 for each day on which the offence continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
